out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BOXES OF FOOD ON FLOOR IN WALK IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PERSONAL BELONGINGS STORED ON RACK WITH BAKING INGREDIENTS AND SUPPLIES.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. EMPLOYEE MOVED PERSONAL BELONGINGS TO DESIGNATED AREA IN BACK OF KITCHEN.
